# lixelv

> Backend and systems developer: LLM applications and agent platforms, Python, Go, C++. Studies at ITMO University. Open to backend and LLM platform work.

This is the plain-text version of https://lixelv.com for language models and other readers. The page itself has interactive demos of the projects below; their descriptions here are the same as on the page.

lixelv does backend development in Python and automation, and likes building tools that solve real problems, from server management to handy development templates.

## Stack

Python, Go, C++, TypeScript, SvelteKit, Swift, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Nginx, JavaScript, automation.

## Work

- [Omnixon](https://omnixon.net/): a platform for AI agents that run in the cloud and are reached through an HTTP API. A solo project created for company internal usage. Agents can use external MCP servers, the whole system is reachable over MCP, and it supports A2A and RAG. Tags: AI agents, HTTP API, cloud.
- [ControlHub](https://github.com/control-hub): a SaaS platform for managing many computers from one place. Write a Python script in the dashboard, pick the machines, and a client on each one runs it and reports back. Supports OAuth2 sign-in. Tags: SvelteKit, PocketBase (Go), Python.
- [Polycode](https://py.lixelv.com/): a web IDE for learning Python and C++. Code runs in the browser through WebAssembly, never on a server, and live sessions sync peer to peer over WebRTC. Tests check your code as you write it. Source: https://github.com/lixelv/polycode. Tags: TypeScript, Go, WebAssembly, WebRTC.
- [GlassChat](https://lixelv.github.io/glasschat/): a native AI chat app for Mac, built with SwiftUI and Liquid Glass. Bring your own API key, pick a model, and connect MCP tools. Source: https://github.com/lixelv/glasschat. Tags: Swift, SwiftUI, MCP.
- [Ionet](https://github.com/lixelv/ionet): a header-only C++ networking library for TCP apps: binary serialization, an ECDH handshake on Curve25519 and ChaCha20 encryption, with zero external dependencies. Tags: C++23, TCP, ECDH, ChaCha20.

## Path

- 2023, first commits: joined GitHub in May and started with Python.
- 2024, bots and web tools: Telegram bots, small apps in Svelte and TypeScript, and a [calculator in plain JavaScript](https://web-calculator-tau.vercel.app/).
- 2025, ControlHub: started the ControlHub GitHub organisation in April. Published Docker templates for FastAPI and aiogram.
- Now, ITMO University: studying, and shipping side projects in C++, Swift and TypeScript.
